results.quote: bd-owned mode is the pour mode in which sc-compose leaves `{{ }}` expressions in the formula for bd to render from `--var` values, as sc-compose v1.7.0 does. With advanced pour, graph pour by path and attach accept caller bead inputs; with `--render-by bd`, they reject those inputs exactly as v1.7.0 does (graph pour by path: `BEADS_GRAPH_FORMULA_UNSUPPORTED` with reason `bead_variables_set`; attach: request error `attach forbids bead_variables`).
